generation.scope: Every moving line-fiber center sweeps a pencil in a plane, with the whole line of centers as the inverse fiber at the pencil vertex. Smooth quadrics force a separated arrow and cones force three consecutive-side pure relations with a common letter. The plane slice forces a nonzero pure relation on the opposite edge. Consequently pure-relation-free regular windows have only finitely many exceptional line fibers.

open_mathematics: Treat isolated line fibers and plane pencils with an opposite pure relation, as well as the remaining finite point-scheme charts and their global orbit structure.
